en.title: Medal of Honor Fan Remake Gets Beloved Cut Level
en.summary: A passionate fan has breathed new life into the 1999 PlayStation classic, Medal of Honor. The Unreal Engine 5 remake has proven so popular that its creator has added a previously unreleased mission.
en.body:
The World War II shooter genre owes a significant debt to the original **Medal of Honor**. While EA's franchise has seen its ups and downs, with recent efforts like the VR spinoff proving unsuccessful, the series' foundational impact on games like **Call of Duty** is undeniable. Now, a dedicated fan has taken it upon themselves to bring the 1999 PlayStation debut to PC in stunning detail.

Developed by Elber88, the **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** is a ground-up recreation built in Unreal Engine 5. It meticulously blends bespoke game logic with assets from the PC-centric **Medal of Honor: Allied Assault**, effectively allowing players to experience the series' origin on a platform it never officially graced back in 1999. Released on February 26, 2026, this ambitious project has garnered significant attention and praise from longtime fans of the series.

## A Blast From The Past, Reimagined

The initial release of the **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** was already a remarkable achievement, faithfully recreating the spirit and gameplay of the original. However, the project's success has spurred further development. Version 1.1, released recently, not only incorporates numerous fixes and player-requested improvements but also adds a substantial new piece of content: a mission set in the infamous Colditz Castle. This level was originally conceptualized for the 1999 game but was ultimately cut, existing only in fragmented data and screenshots. Elber88 has taken this limited information and creatively reconstructed a playable experience, reportedly involving intelligence gathering and an assassination attempt on the castle commandant, offering a compelling glimpse into what might have been.

## Community Enthusiasm Fuels Development

The overwhelming popularity of the remake has been a powerful motivator for its creator. "I am glad to invite you to play the updated versions 1.1 of the remake, which to my surprise has become very popular not only among fans of the original MOH but also among ordinary players," Elber88 stated on ModDB. This positive reception has directly inspired continued work on the project, demonstrating the strong desire for classic gaming experiences to be preserved and modernized. The inclusion of the Colditz Castle level, a piece of lost **Medal of Honor** history, is a testament to this fan dedication and a significant draw for both returning players and newcomers curious about the series' roots.

## What's Next

With the successful integration of a cut level and ongoing updates based on player feedback, the **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** continues to evolve. While specific future content plans have not been detailed, the creator's commitment suggests that further enhancements and perhaps even more rediscovered content could be on the horizon for this passion project.

tr.title: Madalya Onur Hayran Remake'i Sevilen Kesilmiş Seviyeyi Kazanıyor
tr.summary: 1999 PlayStation klasigi Madalya Onur, bir hayran tarafından Unreal Engine 5 ile yeniden canlandırıldı. Remake o kadar popüler oldu ki, yaratıcısı daha önce yayınlanmamış bir misyon ekledi. Bu seviye, orijinal 1999 oyununda kavramsalize edilmiş ancak kesilmiş Colditz Kalesi'nde geçiyor.
tr.body:
## Geçmişten Bir Patlama, Yeniden Düşünülerek

Orijinal **Madalya Onur** oyunu, II. Dünya Savaşı shooter türünün temelini oluşturdu. EA'nın franchise'ı, son yıllarda **Call of Duty** gibi oyunları etkilemesine rağmen, bazı başarısızlıklar yaşadı. Ancak bir hayran, 1999'da PlayStation'da yayınlanan bu oyunu, Unreal Engine 5 kullanarak PC'ye getirdi.

Elber88 tarafından geliştirilen **Madalya Onur Retro Remake**, orijinal oyunun ruhunu ve oyun mekaniklerini koruyarak, PC için yeniden yaratıldı. 26 Şubat 2026'da yayınlanan bu proje, uzun süredir seriyi takip eden hayranlardan önemli dikkat ve övgü aldı.

## Topluluk Coşkusu Gelişimi Hızlandırıyor

Remake'in popülaritesi, yaratıcısı için güçlü bir motivasyon kaynağı oldu. Elber88, ModDB'de "Beni şaşırtan bir şekilde, sadece orijinal MOH hayranları arasında değil, aynı zamanda sıradan oyuncular arasında da çok popüler olan remake'in 1.1 sürümünü oynamaya davet etmekten mutluluk duyuyorum" dedi. Bu olumlu geri bildirim, projenin devam etmesini sağladı ve klasik oyun deneyimlerinin korunması ve modernleştirilmesine yönelik güçlü bir arzuyu gösterdi. Colditz Kalesi seviyesinin dahil edilmesi, **Madalya Onur** tarihindeki kayıp bir parça ve hem geri dönen oyuncular hem de serinin köklerine merak duyan yeni oyuncular için önemli bir çekicilik noktası.

## Gelecek Nedir

Kesilmiş bir seviyenin başarılı bir şekilde entegre edilmesi ve oyuncuların geri bildirimi doğrultusunda devam eden güncellemelerle, **Madalya Onur Retro Remake** devam ediyor. Belirli gelecek içerik planları açıklanmasa da, yaratıcının taahhüdü, bu tutkulu projenin daha da gelişeceği ve belki de daha fazla kayıp içeriklerin keşfedileceği anlamına geliyor.

es.title: Remake de Medal of Honor por fanático incluye nivel eliminado querido
es.summary: Un fanático apasionado ha resucitado el clásico de PlayStation de 1999, Medal of Honor, con una remake en Unreal Engine 5. El proyecto ha sido tan popular que su creador ha agregado una misión que nunca se lanzó. La comunidad de jugadores ha recibido con entusiasmo esta nueva versión, que incluye mejoras y un nivel completamente nuevo ambientado en el Castillo de Colditz.
es.body:
El género de shooters de la Segunda Guerra Mundial debe un gran reconocimiento al original **Medal of Honor**. Aunque la franquicia de EA ha tenido sus altibajos, con esfuerzos recientes como el spin-off de realidad virtual que no ha tenido éxito, el impacto fundamental de la serie en juegos como **Call of Duty** es innegable. Ahora, un fanático dedicado ha decidido revivir el debut de PlayStation de 1999 en PC con detalles impresionantes.

Desarrollado por Elber88, el **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** es una recreación desde cero construida en Unreal Engine 5. Combina meticulosamente la lógica de juego personalizada con activos de **Medal of Honor: Allied Assault**, lo que permite a los jugadores experimentar el origen de la serie en una plataforma que nunca oficialmente lanzó en 1999. Lanzado el 26 de febrero de 2026, este proyecto ambicioso ha generado una gran atención y elogios de los fanáticos de la serie.

## Un regreso al pasado, reinventado

El lanzamiento inicial del **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** ya era un logro notable, recreando fielmente el espíritu y la jugabilidad del original. Sin embargo, el éxito del proyecto ha impulsado un desarrollo adicional. La versión 1.1, lanzada recientemente, no solo incorpora numerosas correcciones y mejoras solicitadas por los jugadores, sino que también agrega un contenido sustancial nuevo: una misión ambientada en el infame Castillo de Colditz. Este nivel fue originalmente conceptualizado para el juego de 1999 pero fue eliminado, existiendo solo en datos fragmentados y capturas de pantalla. Elber88 ha tomado esta información limitada y ha reconstruido creativamente una experiencia jugable, que aparentemente involucra la recopilación de inteligencia y un intento de asesinato del comandante del castillo, ofreciendo una visión convincente de lo que podría haber sido.

## El entusiasmo de la comunidad impulsa el desarrollo

La popularidad abrumadora de la remake ha sido un motivador poderoso para su creador. > "Me alegra invitarlos a jugar las versiones actualizadas 1.1 de la remake, que para mi sorpresa se ha vuelto muy popular no solo entre los fanáticos del original MOH, sino también entre jugadores comunes", declaró Elber88 en ModDB. Esta recepción positiva ha inspirado directamente el trabajo continuo en el proyecto, demostrando el fuerte deseo de preservar y modernizar experiencias de juegos clásicos. La inclusión del nivel del Castillo de Colditz, un trozo de la historia perdida de **Medal of Honor**, es un testimonio de esta dedicación de los fanáticos y un gran atractivo para jugadores que regresan y nuevos curiosos sobre las raíces de la serie.

## Próximos Pasos

Con la integración exitosa de un nivel eliminado y actualizaciones continuas basadas en la retroalimentación de los jugadores, el **Medal of Honor Retro Remake** sigue evolucionando. Aunque no se han detallado planes de contenido específicos para el futuro, el compromiso del creador sugiere que podrían estar en el horizonte mejoras adicionales y quizás incluso más contenido redescubierto para este proyecto de pasión.

content_raw: EA may have given up on Medal of Honor after Respawn's ambitious yet unsuccessful VR spinoff , but there's still a strong cohort of fans of the World War 2 shooter series that laid the groundwork for Call of Duty. Only last month, a developer going by Elber88 released a ground-up remake of the very first Medal of Honor—released on PlayStation in 1999—built in Unreal Engine 4 using original game logic and assets from Medal of Honor: Allied Assault , meaning you can essentially play the series debut on PC for the very first time. This, it turns out, has gone down very well with Medal of Honor fans. So well, in fact, that Elber decided to continue developing the remake a little further. Version 1.1 of Medal of Honor Retro Remake not only spruces up the initial release in several ways, but it also includes an extra level that was cut from the original game. "I am glad to invite you to play the updated versions 1.1 of the remake, which to my surprise has become very popular not only among fans of the original MOH but also among ordinary players," Elber wrote on ModDB . "This inspired me to continue working in my free time and do it for the community." (Image credit: Elber88) Version 1.1 includes "many fixes and most of the wishes and improvements from players," though Elber doesn't go into specifics. However, Elber does provide some information on that extra level, which is set in the infamous Colditz Castle. According to the Medal of Honor wiki , this mission mostly exists in several screenshots and information in the games LEVEL.BIN files, which suggest it would have involved intelligence gathering and assassinating the castle commandant. Elber acknowledges that the mission is based on "very limited information" and so he has understandably taken some creative license in building it. "The current implementation can be considered as my vision," he writes. You can download the updated Medal of Honor: Retro Remake via ModDB . I played a little of the previously released version last month, and it seemed like a well-put together remake, although the absence of the original game's animations was something of a shame.
